prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1483; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet, if that's okay. My lawyer said I could give the facts first.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on the main road in Pearland, heading toward the shopping center near the bridge. It was in the afternoon, around rush hour.
Q: What happened right before the impact?
A: The other car came over into my lane. I braked and swerved to the right, but the front of their vehicle still hit mine. It was almost head-on, but the speed was low. Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. I just felt a hard jolt and my seat belt locked across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: Yes, I got out and walked around for a few minutes. My neck felt stiff and my lower back was sore, but I didn't think much of it at the time.
Q: When did you first notice the back pain getting worse?
A: The next morning. When I got out of bed, the pain went from my lower back down into my hip. Bending over was hard, and sitting for long periods made it worse.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic two days later. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral for physical therapy. I've been going to therapy twice a week.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?
A: Yes. Some days are better than others. Lifting anything heavy still hurts, and I've had to take time off work.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm willing to provide my medical records and the repair estimate for my car. I'd like this handled as quickly as possible.
Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
A: Thank you.
